title: E-commerce Product Filter
description: Build a product filter system for an e-commerce store. You'll render products, filter by category, search by name, sort by price, and combine filters together.

steps.title: Product list render
steps.description: Create a `products` array with at least 5 products. Each product has `id`, `name`, `category`, and `price`. Create a `renderProducts` function that returns a formatted string of all products.
hints: Each product: { id: 1, name: '...', category: '...', price: 9.99 }
Use .map() to format each product as a string

verification.successMessage: Products render with name, price, and category!
verification.failureMessage: Make sure you have at least 5 products and each is formatted as 'name - $price (category)'.

steps.title: Category filter
steps.description: Create a `filterByCategory` function that takes a category string and returns only products in that category.
hints: Compare product.category to the given category string

verification.successMessage: Category filter returns only matching products!
verification.failureMessage: Make sure filterByCategory('clothing') returns only clothing products.

steps.title: Search by name
steps.description: Create a `searchByName` function that takes a search query string and returns products whose name contains the query (case-insensitive).
hints: Convert both the product name and the query to lowercase for case-insensitive search
Use .includes() to check if the name contains the query

verification.successMessage: Search finds products by name, case-insensitive!
verification.failureMessage: Make sure searchByName('phone') returns Smartphone and searchByName('lap') returns Laptop.

steps.title: Sort by price
steps.description: Create `sortByPriceAsc` and `sortByPriceDesc` functions that sort products by price in ascending and descending order.
hints: Create a copy of the array with .slice() before sorting to avoid mutation

verification.successMessage: Sorting works! Ascending shows cheapest first, descending shows most expensive first.
verification.failureMessage: Make sure ascending sort has lowest price first and descending has highest price first.

steps.title: Combined filters
steps.description: Create a `filterProducts` function that accepts a `filters` object with `category`, `search`, and `sort` properties and applies all filters in order.
hints: Start with the full products array
Apply category filter if filters.category is provided
Apply search filter if filters.search is provided
Apply sort if filters.sort is provided ('asc' or 'desc')
Chain the operations: filter -> filter -> sort

verification.successMessage: Your e-commerce filter is complete! Category, search, and sort all work together.
verification.failureMessage: Make sure combined filters apply all specified filters correctly.
